title: AgentScope Trace
description: Schema for an AgentScope trace file. A trace file captures one or more agent runs, each composed of ordered timeline actions.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the AgentScope trace schema this file conforms to.

runs.description: One or more agent runs captured in this trace file.

title.description: Human-readable summary of what the agent was asked to do.

agent.description: Name or identifier of the AI agent that performed this run (e.g. 'Claude Code').

branch.description: Git branch the agent worked on.

status.description: Overall outcome of the run. 'warning' means the agent completed the task but reviewers should inspect closely.

trustScore.description: Confidence score (0-100) for this run based on heuristics like test pass rate, edit scope, and error recovery.

cost.description: Estimated API cost for the run (e.g. '$0.38').

filesChanged.description: Number of files the agent modified during this run.

commands.description: Number of shell commands the agent executed during this run.

actions.description: Ordered timeline of actions the agent performed.

id.description: Unique identifier for this action within the run (e.g. 'a1').

type.description: Category of the action. Determines the icon and color used in the timeline.

title.description: Short label shown in the timeline for this action.

risk.description: Risk level of this action. 'high' means the action touched production code or ran a potentially destructive command.

summary.description: One-to-two sentence summary of what happened in this action.

details.description: Bullet-point evidence notes that support the summary.

file.description: Path to the file this action read or edited. Present for read_file and edit_file actions.

command.description: Shell command that was executed. Present for run_command, test_failed, and test_passed actions.

output.description: Captured stdout or stderr from the action. May contain test output, command logs, or AI-generated summaries.

diff.description: Unified diff produced by this action. Present for edit_file actions.
